Keep cluster trees inside the facet strip

Source: R/cluster-strip.R
strip_cluster.Rd

scale_x_cluster() and scale_y_cluster() mark the plot automatically, so trees attached with position = "top" are moved between the strip and the panel as soon as the plot is drawn. When the tree comes from a second guide added with ggplot2::guides (for example guides(x.top = guide_axis_cluster(...))), wrap the plot in strip_cluster() once to get the same layout.

Usage

strip_cluster(plot)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

Value

The same plot with the strip layout enabled.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p <- ggplot(df, aes(gene, sample)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype, scales = "free") +
  guides(x.top = guide_axis_cluster(mat, free = TRUE, position = "top"))
strip_cluster(p)
} # }
